name: Thoracic Extension Stretch
instructions: Sit or kneel and place your mid-back over a foam roller or bench edge.
Support your head with your hands.
Extend backward over the roller, opening the chest — ribs down, movement from the mid-back.
Work different segments of the mid-back and repeat.
cues: Stay relaxed outside the target area
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: A beginner just your bodyweight mobility drill targeting the upper back. Thoracic Extension Stretch restores range of motion that desk life and hard training both tend to steal.
